subject: Invitation: Case Study Spotlight at ScaleOps Summit — short panel + demo
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@sablehealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Invitation: Case Study Spotlight at ScaleOps Summit — short panel + demo

Hi Aisha —

Hope you’re well. Quick ask: ScaleOps Summit (Jan 25–26, 2027) is curating a short "Case Study Spotlight" track for customers who have production stories to share. We’d love to feature Sable Health in a 20-minute slot (10-minute moderated discussion + 10-minute live demo).

What we’re proposing:
- Date: Jan 25 (afternoon slot — exact time TBC)
- Format: 10-min moderated Q&A (panel style) followed by a 10-min hands-on demo of how you use Redwood Inference in your triage pipeline
- Audience: ~200 practitioners and platform engineers (mostly healthcare + ML ops)

We’ll provide: a session moderator, a short prep call, and we can handle travel if you’d like to attend in person. Attached are a one-page session outline and our speaker guide.

Could you confirm:
1) If Sable would be interested in participating?
2) Who would present from your side (name / title)?
3) Whether you’re comfortable with a short live demo using a sandbox/demo account we provide?
4) Any legal / approval needs we should know about (data use, logo usage, NDAs)?

If helpful, I can propose two times for a 30-min dry run in early Jan.

Really appreciate you considering this — your work on the Redwood integration has been a great story and would be super helpful for other health tech teams.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Marketing
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Invitation: Case Study Spotlight at ScaleOps Summit — short panel + demo

Hi Marissa —

Thank you — we’d be honored to participate. A few quick notes from our side:
- We can confirm interest and likely present with our Senior ML Engineer, Raj Singh (raj.singh@sablehealth.com).
- We are fine with the 20-minute format; a short demo is OK so long as the demo uses anonymized/sample data. Our legal/compliance team requires confirmation that no PHI will be used and that any recordings are for marketing/educational use only.
- Preferred: virtual participation (one of us can be remote); Raj might travel if the timing works.

Availability: Jan 25 afternoon is workable for us. For the 30-min dry run, Raj is available Jan 10–14 (PST) in the afternoons.

Can you confirm what environment you’ll provide for the demo (ephemeral token vs. customer sandbox)? Also, does Redwood need a signed speaker agreement or can we route through our internal approvals? I’ll loop in legal if you could share the typical speaker agreement.

Thanks — will cc Raj and our events mailbox once you confirm.

—Aisha
Aisha Patel
Head of Platform Partnerships
Sable Health

Hi Aisha —

Great — thrilled you’re up for it. Answers inline and next steps below.

1) Demo environment: we’ll provide an ephemeral demo workspace (ephemeral API key + sandbox dataset) hosted in us-west-2. No customer PHI will be included — we’ll only use synthetic/anonymized records. Karthik, can you set up the ephemeral account and share credentials to Raj directly (secure email)?

2) Speaker agreement / approvals: we have a short speaker agreement that covers recording and logo use — not an NDA. I’ve attached the Speaker_Guide which includes the sample speaker agreement language. If Sable needs our legal template, I can share the HubSpot DocuSign link.

3) Logistics & next steps:
- Karthik to create ephemeral demo workspace and schedule a tech dry run with Raj (target dates: Jan 10–14).
- Stephanie to confirm final session time and moderator intro (we’ll aim for Jan 25, 2:30–2:50pm PT).
- Aisha / Raj to share a 2–3 sentence customer blurb and a headshot by Dec 15 for the program page.

Related links: HubSpot deal + speaker materials: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deals/D-98721 and shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcDefG-shareable

Action items for this thread (summary):
- [Karthik] Set up ephemeral demo workspace and send secure creds to Raj (by Dec 5)
- [Raj / Aisha] Share speaker blurb + headshot (by Dec 15)
- [Stephanie] Lock session time and moderator (by Dec 10)

If that timeline works I’ll mark Sable as confirmed on the ScaleOps site. Thanks again.
